channel.title: North Wales Pioneer - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from North Wales Pioneer (northwalespioneer.co.uk)

item.title: Part of Plas Road in Llandudno to close to vehicles for up to six weeks
item.description: Plas Road in the Great Orme area will be closed for up to six weeks for maintenance.

item.title: Added space and new designs as charity shop is given major refit
item.description: A charity shop has reopened with a brand new look.

item.title: Colwyn Bay psychiatric unit 'placing people’s dignity, safety and well-being at risk'
item.description: A psychiatric unit in Colwyn Bay is in need of "significant improvement", after a care body said it was "placing people’s dignity, safety and well-being at risk".

item.title: Conwy village gets mobile coverage for the first time as residents rejoice
item.description: Residents and businesses in a scenic village in Conwy county are celebrating the start of a new, connected era after reliable mobile connectivity was delivered to the community.

item.title: ‘999? I’ve got a wobbly tooth!’ – Non-emergency calls to Welsh Ambulance revealed
item.description: The Welsh Ambulance Service has revealed more about some of the strangest non-emergency calls they received throughout 2025.

item.title: Llandudno hotel on the market voted best in town has its price slashed
item.description: The Elm Tree, on North Parade, was also nominated within one per cent of hotels worldwide by TripAdvisor as 'Best of the Best 2023.

item.title: War of words erupts over Conwy Reform leader’s plans for Llandudno Town Hall
item.description: The row follows a dispute between the Conservatives and Reform after Tory councillor Harry Saville revealed early plans proposed by the Reform leader.

item.title: Acclaimed Conwy restaurant named one of the UK’s Top 100
item.description: Conwy’s acclaimed restaurant The Jackdaw has been named one of the UK’s Top 100 Restaurants for 2026, with chef Nick Rudge’s modern Welsh cooking earning national praise and cementing the town’s growing reputation as a culinary destination.

item.title: Weeks of disruption ahead as A55 roadworks set to begin
item.description: Major roadworks are set to cause weeks of disruption on a key stretch of the A55.

item.title: RECAP: Road re-opens after emergency services attend scene of crash
item.description: Police are currently in attendance at a road traffic collision on the A55 Ewloe east bound. Motorists are being asked to avoid the area if possible.
